streets.note: existed 1920 on the same alignment; west of Sochaczewska it continued west as the road to Bärenwinkel (gardener Lenz nursery). Name since 1902.
existed 1920; the northern part (north of Mickiewicza) ended at Justweg / Hst. Reichskolonie; the southern part existed with the Wohnungs-Genossenschaft rows on both sides.
on the 1920 plan the road/stream south of the colony runs on a slightly different (more diagonal NW-SE) course; 1933 plan shows Leegstrieß on today's alignment.
not on the 1920 plan (laid out with the 1920s/30s housing south of the Strießbach); present on 1933 plan.
Ostseestraße was laid out from 1920; not on the 1920 plan.
